spec_match.rationale: Tests single-string CSS Overflow Level 4 text-overflow values (' (more)', ' ➔', ' […]', '…（続き）') via CSS.supports('text-overflow', '<string>') and getComputedStyle(el).textOverflow.

interactive.rationale: Preset buttons, custom string input, container width slider, and editable headline text dynamically update both the real CSS target element and the side-by-side visual reference.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Matches the index card promise: interactive custom string builder with live container width slider, CSS.supports + getComputedStyle probe, and side-by-side simulated preview.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers CJK/multi-byte strings ('…（続き）'), wide container widths where overflow disappears, and honest fallback detection when the engine drops custom string declarations.

references.rationale: Links to chromestatus.com/feature/6294595288825856, CSS Overflow Module Level 4, and MDN.

conformance.rationale: Pairs directly with the feature conformance suite's css-supports-single-string and computed-style-serializes-custom-string assertions.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Verified live probe readout, width slider reflow, and side-by-side fallback simulation without console errors or horizontal overflow.

telemetry_health.rationale: Emits showcaseTelemetry assertions recording CSS.supports status, computed style serialization, active marker string, and container width.

design_system.rationale: Uses only CSS custom properties from /public/styles.css, enforces explicit background+color pairs on buttons, and guarantees 44px minimum touch target heights.

accessibility.rationale: All form inputs have explicit labels, preset toggles expose aria-pressed state, pre blocks have tabindex=0, and live-readout uses aria-live=polite.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Responsive auto-fit grid and max-width: 100% truncation frames keep both 360x740 mobile and 1280x800 desktop viewports free of unintended horizontal overflow.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Associate every form control with a visible <label> and group related controls inside <fieldset> and <legend>.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Wrapped marker and container sizing controls in semantic <fieldset>/<legend> blocks with explicit <label for> bindings and 44px minimum control heights.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Communicate visual state updates to assistive technology via aria-live regions and preserve full text accessibility.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Added role=status / aria-live=polite readouts explaining when truncation activates while confirming the underlying DOM text remains intact.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Adapt preview containers cleanly across narrow mobile and wide desktop viewports without causing horizontal page overflow.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Constrained preview frames with max-width: 100% and box-sizing: border-box inside responsive auto-fit grids.

summary: Interactive custom string builder for CSS text-overflow: <string> with live CSS.supports and getComputedStyle telemetry plus an accurate side-by-side reference preview.
